title: High ingestion latency on oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01
query: Investigate high ingestion latency on oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01 for the past 6 hours
thoughts: I'll start by examining the end-to-end latency metrics for stamp `oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01` over the past 6 hours. This will help identify which latency percentile is degraded and when the issue began.

thoughts.content: The p95 latency has spiked to **4,800ms** (baseline ~1,200ms) starting around 08:30 UTC. Let me check which processing stage is contributing the most to this latency increase by breaking down the pipeline stages.

Interesting — the **Delta Service** stage accounts for 72% of the total latency. The queue wait time is normal, but the Delta Service processing time jumped from 400ms to 3,200ms. Let me investigate the Delta Service metrics and check for any recent deployments.

input.query:
TeleductMetrics
| where Stamp == 'oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01'
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where MetricName == 'E2ELatencyMs'
| summarize
    p50=percentile(Value, 50),
    p95=percentile(Value, 95),
    p99=percentile(Value, 99)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20

TeleductMetrics
| where Stamp == 'oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01'
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where MetricName in ('QueueWaitMs', 'DeltaServiceMs', 'PayloadFannerMs', 'KustoIngestionMs')
| summarize p95=percentile(Value, 95) by MetricName, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| order by TimeGenerated desc, MetricName asc

| where Stamp == 'oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01'
| where TimeGenerated > ago(12h)
| project TimeGenerated, CommitId, Version, ChangeDescription
| order by TimeGenerated desc
